## 1. Purpose and deployable entry points
DataAgent is an enterprise AI data analyst: conversational NL-to-SQL, optional sandboxed Python analysis, and report/chart generation. The backend is a Java 17+/Spring Boot application rooted at `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/DataAgentApplication.java`; its API surface is exposed by controllers such as `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/controller/ChatController.java` and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/controller/GraphController.java`.

A separate Nuxt frontend provides the browser UI, entering through `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/app.vue` and route pages including `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/pages/chat.vue`. Container deployment is defined by `docker-file/docker-compose.yml`, `docker-file/Dockerfile-backend`, and `docker-file/Dockerfile-frontend`.

## 2. API, security, and application boundary
Controllers separate HTTP/WebFlux concerns from domain services for agents, data sources, knowledge, models, prompts, sessions, and graph execution. Responses use API/streaming-oriented value objects, including `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/vo/ChatResponse.java` and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/vo/SessionUpdateEvent.java`.

Reactive API-key authentication is configured at `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/config/WebFluxSecurityConfiguration.java`, implemented through `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/security/AgentApiKeyReactiveAuthenticationManager.java`, and backed by credential lifecycle handling in `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/security/ApiKeyCredentialService.java`.

## 3. Conversational graph orchestration
`GraphServiceImpl` is the orchestration boundary from chat requests into a stateful Spring AI Alibaba Graph workflow: `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/graph/GraphServiceImpl.java`. Streaming and multi-turn state are managed by `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/graph/Context/StreamContext.java` and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/graph/Context/MultiTurnContextManager.java`.

The workflow decomposes requests into graph nodes and dispatchers: recognize intent/feasibility, enhance the query, recall schema/evidence, validate semantics, plan and execute, then produce a report. Core node implementations live in `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/workflow/node/PlannerNode.java`, `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/workflow/node/SqlGenerateNode.java`, and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/workflow/node/ReportGeneratorNode.java`. Human feedback is an explicit control-flow branch via `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/workflow/node/HumanFeedbackNode.java`.

## 4. Data access and NL2SQL execution
Agent-specific datasource configuration and schema metadata drive SQL generation and execution. `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/nl2sql/Nl2SqlServiceImpl.java` provides the NL2SQL service boundary; prompt templates are externalized under `data-agent-management/src/main/resources/prompts/`, including `new-sql-generate.txt` and `planner.txt`.

The connector layer abstracts database access, dialect DDL, pools, and result conversion through `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/connector/SqlExecutor.java`, `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/connector/accessor/AccessorFactory.java`, and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/connector/pool/DBConnectionPoolFactory.java`. Concrete support includes MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Hive, H2, and Dameng. MySQL is the primary management-store runtime expectation, with schema at `data-agent-management/src/main/resources/sql/schema.sql`.

## 5. Knowledge, retrieval, and model runtime
Business knowledge, agent knowledge, semantic models, logical relations, and datasource schema are persisted as domain entities and used as retrieval context. The ingestion lifecycle is centered on `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/knowledge/AgentKnowledgeServiceImpl.java` and asynchronous embedding events in `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/event/AgentKnowledgeEventListener.java`.

Vector retrieval is abstracted behind `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/vectorstore/AgentVectorStoreServiceImpl.java`; configurations indicate Milvus and Elasticsearch alternatives in `data-agent-management/src/main/resources/application-milvus.yml` and `data-agent-management/src/main/resources/application-elasticsearch.yml`. Hybrid Elasticsearch retrieval and reciprocal-rank fusion are implemented in `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/hybrid/retrieval/impl/ElasticsearchHybridRetrievalStrategy.java` and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/hybrid/fusion/impl/RrfFusionStrategy.java`.

LLM and embedding providers are dynamically registered/configured via `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/aimodelconfig/AiModelRegistry.java` and `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/aimodelconfig/DynamicModelFactory.java`.

## 6. Analysis output, integrations, and frontend flow
Workflow plans may execute generated Python after SQL extraction; the isolation boundary is `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/code/sandbox/SaaSandboxPythonCodeExecutorService.java` and its task runtime `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/code/sandbox/runtime/SaaSandboxRuntime.java`. Docker is materially required for this sandbox path.

The backend can also operate as an MCP tool server through `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/mcp/McpServerService.java`, and emits Langfuse-oriented node tracing through `data-agent-management/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/dataagent/service/langfuse/NodeTracingLifecycleListener.java`.

The Nuxt UI calls backend service modules, maintains chat state, and renders streamed workflow progress/results: `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/services/chat/index.ts`, `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/stores/chat.ts`, and `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/components/chat/ChatWorkflowTimeline.vue`. Markdown reports and ECharts rendering are handled at `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/components/chat/ChatMarkdownReport.vue` and `data-agent-frontend-nuxt/app/utils/markdown/markdown-plugin-echarts.ts`.
